title: Why PlayStation 1 Graphics Warped and Wobbled so much | MVG
summary: Modern Vintage Gamer explains why PlayStation 1 graphics warped and jittered, comparing it with the Nintendo 64. The causes are affine texture mapping and the lack of sub-pixel vertex precision.
why: Used as the accessible explanation of PS1 rendering quirks whenever retro 3D graphics or PS1-style renderers come up.

quote.text: The explanation actually blew my mind.
